description: When the user would reach a savings target they do not have as a goal yet: "how long to save 6 million for a trip at 500 thousand a month?". Give the target and, if they said them, the monthly amount and what they already have (without a monthly amount Bluu uses what they have left over each month). Bluu saves it to their Simulations, where they can open it and move the numbers. Answer with when they get there, then offer the link. For a goal they already have, use `goals`. Alternatively supply loan or new_subscription instead of target. Loan rates are annual decimals (18% = 0.18), only as the user stated; omit an unknown rate and Bluu labels its assumption. Zero means the user explicitly said interest-free. Savings return rates and inflation are not supported. Show what will be saved and ask for approval before calling: this saves a simulation.

already_saved.description: What they already have toward it, if they said.

loan.description: A loan purchase. Supply exactly one of target, loan or new_subscription.

loan_annual_rate.description: Annual decimal: 18% = 0.18. Only a user-stated rate; zero only if explicitly interest-free. Omit for an assumed rate.

loan_category.description: The kind of loan the user named.

purchase_price.description: Purchase price in the stated currency.

monthly_contribution.description: What they would set aside each month, if they said.

name.description: How the user calls it: "Trip to Japan".

new_subscription.description: A hypothetical recurring charge; does not create a subscription.

space.description: Space name. Omit for the user's personal space.

target.description: The savings amount to reach. Omit for loan or new_subscription.

name: what_if
title: Try a What-If
